problem.locked: Too many wrong PINs: wait a few minutes or ask your team leader.
problem.unavailable: The office did not answer. Try again.
problem.offline: Signing needs the network. Wait for it, then sign.

forbidden.title: You may not do this here
forbidden.body: Your role does not allow it at this station. Ask your team leader.

notFound.title: Not found at this site
notFound.body: Nothing with this code at this site. Check the label, or ask your team leader.

conflict.title: It changed meanwhile
conflict.body: Someone changed it a moment ago. It was read again: check it and try once more.

invalid.title: This was not accepted
invalid.body: The office did not accept it as it was sent. Check the numbers and try again.

signedOut.title: You were signed out
signedOut.body: Your session ended. Sign in again: nothing saved on this tablet is lost.

rateLimited.title: Too many tries
rateLimited.body: Wait a moment, then try again.

offline.title: No network
offline.body: This needs the network. It comes back by itself; then try again.

unavailable.title: The office does not answer
unavailable.body: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.

keys.title: Keys
keys.enter: Open the row with the focus
keys.scan: Scan a label: opens it at once

notOnTablet.title: Not on this tablet
notOnTablet.body: The tablet has no copy of it and there is no network. Do it when the network is back, or ask your team leader.
